summary: Peer Q1 verified and implemented: submitting '[N]' instead of '[Player N]' makes day-vote targets survive the ordinary TextArena observation stream. No out-of-band reconstruction is needed, and the native channel is strictly better than the reconstructed arm. Q5 metric rename also done. Next is the paired cross-play harness.
round_goal: First material delta of peer gate 0016: verify native day-vote observability through the ordinary observation pipeline with an integration test, without reading backstage state.

result.mechanism: SecretMafiaEnv._record_vote broadcasts day votes to all players with broadcast_to_all=True, but textarena.core.State.add_observation strips every '[Player N]' role tag from PLAYER_ACTION messages. SecretMafia's own phase prompts ask for the '[X]' form and VoteHandler's pattern accepts both, so the runner was using a form the environment destroys.

controlled_comparison.method: Same policy, same seed, same player count, only the action encoding differs.

result.conclusion: The native channel fully replaces the reconstruction and is slightly better on every role and phase. The reconstructed arm is retained only as a labelled sensitivity result for the legacy encoding; the runner now raises if both are enabled at once, because that would double-count the same evidence.

decisions_implemented.Q1: Done. Native '[N]' encoding is the default; 'player_tag' is kept only so the difference can be tested. Six new tests cover it, including the negative control and a controlled comparison showing the encodings differ only in observability.
decisions_implemented.Q5_partial: Done. mean_action_regret is renamed to mean_immediate_target_loss_diagnostic in both storybox_sck_eval_v0.py and the harness, with the rename recorded in every new artifact via metric_notes. Artifacts also carry a primary_metrics block naming the peer's primary and secondary metric sets so no reader can mistake the diagnostic for an acceptance metric.
decisions_implemented.artifact_status: Implemented as an explicit artifact_status_per_peer_decision block in sck-secret-mafia-ab-v0.json: the 50-episode and both 500-episode artifacts are historical diagnostics only and must not be compared against native-encoding runs.
decisions_implemented.Q2_Q3_Q4_Q6: Not started. Q2 paired cross-play is the next round; Q4 replay-calibrated evidence follows it; Q3 and Q6 gates remain held.

verification.offline: python -m pytest on the four SCK-family test files: 39 passed, 13 skipped
verification.live: .venv-textarena/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest on the same files: 52 passed with textarena 0.7.4
verification.information_safety: The native vote channel reads only PLAYER_ACTION observations in the DAY_VOTING phase from the actor's own transcript. The existing runtime guard, decision-path AST audit and per-episode empirical check all still pass, and the new views carry no reconstructed channel at all.

notes_for_the_peer: The switch invalidates the belief variants' previous behaviour but not plain/memory: because target actions are submitted as text, and the environment parses both forms identically, plain and memory reproduce identical outcomes. The belief variants now receive vote evidence by default, so their legacy-encoding numbers no longer describe the current default code path.
The immediate-target-loss diagnostic will be reported in cross-play runs as a secondary diagnostic only, never as the acceptance metric.

No self-play outcome run was performed this round, following the peer instruction to keep the first delta to native visibility plus its test rather than adding more outcome numbers under the demoted metric.
next_gate: Round 7: implement fixed-baseline paired cross-play with shared seeds and identical role schedules, covering informed Village vs baseline Mafia, baseline Village vs informed Mafia, and the same swaps for belief_planning, with terminal cross-play utility and faction win rate as the primary outcome.
action_required: No reply needed unless the peer disagrees with treating the native channel as the primary evidence path. Round 7 is starting.
